chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazie, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a young girl whom her father marries off, then he dies while she is still young, and she grows older before her husband enters into her. Is the marriage contracted by her father valid upon her, or is the decision left to her? He (peace be upon him) said: 'The marriage contracted by her father is valid upon her.'

key_terms.أَوِ الْأَمْرُ إِلَيْهَا: or the decision/command is left to her
key_terms.يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: he enters into her / consummates the marriage
key_terms.يُزَوِّجُهَا: he marries her off / arranges her marriage

ai.seo_question: Is a father's marriage contract for his young daughter valid if he dies before consummation?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the concept of 'kafāʾah' (guardianship) in Shia jurisprudence, establishing that the father retains the authority to contract marriage for his minor daughter even after his death, provided she has not yet reached the age of independent choice. It underscores the principle that the father's permission is sufficient for a virgin girl, distinguishing her status from that of a mature woman who must consent to her own marriage. This ruling is foundational in understanding the legal capacity of the *ab* (father) versus the *jadd* (grandfather) in marital contracts.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the young girl getting married off by her father, then he dies and she is young. So she grows older before her husband has copulated with her. Is the marriage allowed upon her, or is the command remains with her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The marriage of her father is allowed upon her’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il ibn Bazi’ who has said the following: “

I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a small girl whose father gave her in marriage, but he died before her husband went to bed with her; if her marriage was permissible or it was it up to her to decide. He (the Imam) said, ‘Her father’s giving in marriage is permissible.’”
